branches.label: 设计开发者门户
branches.query: Design a production-grade dashboard UI with sidebar, top bar, environment cards, status badges and feature-flag search and filters. Include modern spacing, type hierarchy and dark mode.

branches.label: 编制环境功能 PRD
branches.query: Draft an ephemeral environments PRD for self-service provisioning, TTL teardown, cost tracking and namespace isolation. Include acceptance criteria, constraints and dependencies for TaskMaster.

branches.label: 制定 Git 约定
branches.query: Define Git workflow guardrails with Husky conventional-commit checks, branch naming, a pull request template with screenshots and reviewer checklist, and a documented emergency hotfix procedure.
